pkgmetadata.longdescription: A fork of PCSX2 adding emulation of NAMCO System 246 and 256 arcade hardware. Installs its executable as pcsx2x6-qt and its resources under /usr/share/pcsx2x6, so it can be installed alongside games-emulation/pcsx2.

use.flag: Build with llvm-core/clang, which is the only compiler upstream supports
Enable support for the media-sound/sndio backend
